s: Din mayim acharonim, ubo t' seipim: mayim acharonim mitzva mishshum qedushsha, lehitqaddesh lebarek Hashem al hammazon, shehayyadayim shehen mezohamot millikluk hammaakal — hen pesulot libraka. Veod hosipu laasot choba gam al otam sheen mazkirin et Hashem bebirkat hammazon ella shomein mehambarek, lepi sheameru: "achar kol akilateka ekol melach", veyesh melach sedomit shemmesamme et haenayim, veyesh lachosh shemma naga beyadayv begargir melach sedomit o melach acher shettibo kemelach sedomit shehaya meorab bammelach sheakelu achar hasseuda, ukesheyyitten achar kak yadayv al enayv yesamme otan im lo yittol yadayv techilla. Lepikak, en lahem lebarek al netila zo, kemo sheen mebarekin al shemira mishshear sakkanot, kegon hamsannen mayim ballayla mippene sakkanot aluqa vekayyotze bazeh. Abal hambarek shennotel yadayv mishshum mitzva uqedushsha haya rauy sheyyebarek aleha, ella lepi sheakshav en osin hammitzva ketaqqanat chakamim uminhagam, shehayu nohagim limshoach hayyadayim beshemen areb achar hannetila lehaabir hazzuhama mehayyadayim, veakshav en lanu shemen areb, vekevan sheen anu osim hammitzva ketiqnah — nahagu shello lebarek apillu hambarek birkat hammazon:

Mayim acharonim en notelin al gabbe qarqa ella bikli, mippene ruach raa sheshshora alehem keshehem al gabbe qarqa. Veim en lo keli, notel al gabbe etzim daqqim vekayyotze bahem. Vehu haddin kol dabar shechotzetz benam laqqarqa, apillu ritzpa, sheen ruach raa ella al gabbe qarqa. Ubemaqom sheen bene adam oberim sham yakol littelam al gabbe qarqa. Laken muttar littelam tachat hashshulchan, veap al pi shellipamim mesalleqin hashshulchan, mikkol maqom, ben kak uben kak yitnaggebu:
En notelin bechammin shehayyad soledet bo, mippene shemmepapein et hayyadayim veen maabirin et hazzuhama. Veyesh oserin apillu bechammin sheen hayyad soledet bo. Veyesh lehaqel bedibre soperim:

En tzarik littol ella ad pereq sheni shel etzbaot, shellemala mimmennu eno maggia likluk hammaakal. Veen tzarik lishpok aleha ella paam echat. Veen shiur lemayim shel netila zo, veenam kemayim rishonim sheshshiuram lo pachot merebiit:

Tzarik sheyyashpil rashe etzbeotayv lematta bishat hannetila, kede shettered hazzuhama (velaken en lirchotz yadayv tok hakkeli, ella yishpok alehem kede shettered hazzuhama. Abal emtzaim shebben gebina letabshil shel basar — yakol lerochtzan betok hakkeli):

Im hamsubbin hem rabbim — matchilin min haqqatan, sheggenay hu laggadol littol yadayv veyamtin yosheb batel ad sheyyittelu kullam. Lepikak, matchilin min haqqatan hayyosheb bassop, vehaggadol oseq baakila o bedabar acher ad sheyyaggiu hammayim elayv. Venotelin kullam derek yeshibatam. Veen mekabbedin zeh et zeh, ad sheyyaggiu lachamishsha haacharonim, lepi sheen mekabbedim beyadayim mezohamot, vekevan shello nisharu ella chamishsha shello natelu, sheechad mehen hu hambarek — matchilin min hambarek, veachar kak en mekabbedin zeh et zeh. Veken im en sham ella chamishsha matchilin min hambarek, kede sheyyeayyen bebirkat hammazon beod sheellu haarbaa notelim, sheshshiaru chakamim shebbeshiur netilat arbaa yukal leayyen bed' berakot shel birkat hammazon, veken beshiur zeh en bo hepseq ben netila libraka. Umah sheameru: "tekep lintilat yadayim beraka", lav "tekep" mammash, ella bikde shiur zeh. Mikkol maqom, shello letzorek asur lehapsiq kelal. Velaken mozegin kos shel birkat hammazon qodem hannetila, kede litkop hannetila labberaka bekol mah deepshar. Veasur lehasiach benetayim ezeh eseq veinyan acher, apillu bedibre tora, abal sicha bealma b' veg' tebot — en lachosh ella mishshennatal hakkos beyado lebarek, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qp"g:

Yesh omerim shemmayim acharonim en tzerikim niggub. Veyesh mi sheomer shehambarek menaggeb yadayv techilla veachar kak mebarek. Abal hamsubbin enam tzerikim lenaggeb ledibre hakkol. Vegam bammebarek yesh lehaqel bedibre soperim, ayyen siman qa"g:

Mayim acharonim notelim bekol mine mashqeh, apillu beshemen udebash vechalab, mippene shehem maabirin et hazzuhama, chutz miyyayin sheen notelin bo mippene chashibuto, kemo shennitbaer besiman q"s vqa"a. Veken mayim happesulim larishonim mishshum melaka o shinnuy mareh — kesherim laacharonim:

Yesh sheen nohagim littol mayim acharonim, mippene sheen melach sedomit metzuya benenu, umishshum yadayim mezohamot en chosheshin, hoil veakshav en maqpidin lerochtzan millikluk hammaakal — en zeh qaruy zuhama lanu. Umikkol maqom, mi shehu istenis veragil lirchotz yadayv achar hasseuda — hare hen lo yadayim mezohamot, vetzarik littelan qodem birkat hammazon. Vaapillu rotzeh lebarek al hayyayin beemtza hasseuda — yeqannechan qodem sheyyebarek. Abal nakon lekol adam lizzaher bemayim acharonim:
